status: written before any variant below was trained or scored; frozen by hash in evals/ROUTER_V2_PREREG.sha256 on the first `cascade prepare`, and `cascade evaluate` refuses to run if this file changes
disclosure: Already seen on the eval and shift splits before this was written, while diagnosing v1: per-task failure ROC-AUC of mean_logprob, min_logprob and the v1 router; each existing policy's per-task escalation share and quality at every budget; per-task local and GPT-4o-mini success rates. That diagnosis motivated the variants, so it is disclosed rather than hidden.
No variant below has been trained or scored on any split.
cascade_lr uses every per-pair generation signal already recorded, fixed without selection. That includes min_logprob, whose failure AUC on drafting's eval split was seen to be below 0.5.

target.name: rescue
target.definition: the local adapter fails AND GPT-4o-mini succeeds on the same pair. Success rules are the judged operating curve's: exact label for intent and urgency, span rule for PII, GPT-4o grade >= 4 on both arms for drafting (D38).
target.why: v1 predicted local failure, but escalating a pair the frontier also fails buys nothing. The oracle already ranks by gain (D32); the router's label never did.

gain_text.model: microsoft/deberta-v3-small, router/train.py RouterConfig defaults unchanged, input `task: <name> | <ticket text>`
gain_text.reporting: each seed scored and judged separately; no seed is selected and no ensemble is formed

cascade_lr.model: logistic regression after StandardScaler, both fit on the train split only
cascade_lr.features: per-task intercept, and per-task interactions with mean_logprob, min_logprob, log1p(n_tokens), and finish_reason == 'length'

confidence_per_task.fixes: pooling log-probabilities across tasks whose outputs differ in length
confidence_per_task.score: -(mean_logprob - train-split task mean) / train-split task standard deviation

comparator: confidence: -mean_logprob pooled across tasks — the policy behind the published 57%
primary_endpoint: quality at escalation budget 0.20, with headroom captured against the oracle

uncertainty.method: paired bootstrap of quality(variant) - quality(confidence) at budget 0.20
uncertainty.note: the budget is re-applied inside each resample, so the ranking is re-read on every draw

decision_rule.beats confidence: in-distribution 95% interval entirely above 0 AND shift point estimate above 0; for gain_text, all three seeds must pass
decision_rule.loses to confidence: in-distribution 95% interval entirely below 0; for gain_text, all three seeds
decision_rule.inconclusive: anything else, including seeds that disagree

expected_power: the oracle leaves at most 0.040 of quality above confidence at budget 0.20 in-distribution, on 392 pairs. An interval too wide to pass is a likely outcome and is reported as inconclusive, not as a loss.
reported_regardless: the full operating curve at every budget, both populations
every variant and every seed, whatever the outcome
not_allowed_after_scoring: changing any feature, grid, seed, target, budget or decision rule
adding a variant and reporting only it
